Photorealistic front elevation of a modern beverage vending machine at night, portrait framing, the whole cabinet inside the frame. Dark charcoal metal body, large glass front displaying neat rows of chilled drinks in cans and bottles, cool white LED strip lighting inside, illuminated selection buttons, card reader, coin slot and a delivery flap near the bottom. Fine rain droplets on the glass, a subtle warm street reflection, dark wet pavement behind. Sharp product photography, realistic brushed metal and glass, natural colour. No readable text, no lettering, no brand logos, no watermark.
